overview_description.description:
Atlas Wearables is a fitness-technology company that designs products to enrich the fitness experience both in and out of the gym. It identifies exercises, counts reps and sets, and calculates the calories burned and evaluates form. With the on-wrist display can track every movement across their entire workout and get live feedback to improve form and make adjustments to get stronger, faster. 

Atlas Wearables was founded in 2013 and is based in Austin, Texas, United States.
